meta.name: markdown-to-epub-converter
meta.description: Convert markdown documents and chat summaries into formatted EPUB ebook files that can be read on any device or uploaded to Kindle.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Markdown 文档变成能在任何设备上阅读的 EPUB 电子书
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把 Markdown 笔记或聊天记录整理成电子书随身阅读。
copy.tagline_en: Turn Markdown documents into EPUB ebooks readable on any device.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn your Markdown notes and chat summaries into portable ebooks.

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 能把 Markdown 格式的文档或聊天摘要转换成 EPUB 电子书文件。它会自动用一级标题分章并生成目录,保留粗体、斜体、链接、列表、代码块等格式,最后给你一个可下载的 EPUB 文件。
howto.when: 当你说要把 Markdown 文本或文件转成 EPUB 电子书时触发,比如提供 Markdown 内容或文件路径。

say.note: 会按一级标题自动分章

say.text: 把我们的聊天摘要转成 Markdown 再做成 EPUB

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can convert Markdown documents or chat summaries into an EPUB ebook file. It treats H1 headers as chapters, builds a table of contents, and preserves formatting such as bold, italic, links, lists, and code blocks. A downloadable EPUB file is produced.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you ask to convert Markdown text or a file path into an EPUB ebook, for example by providing the Markdown content or a file path.

say_en.text: Convert this Markdown blog post to an EPUB file.
say_en.note: An EPUB will be generated for download.

say_en.text: Turn my research notes Markdown file into an EPUB ebook.
say_en.note: Chapters are auto-detected from H1 headers.

say_en.text: Convert our chat summary to Markdown and then make an EPUB.
